migration.migration_reason: Preserved paid Language Quality findings were independently re-adjudicated against the current fixed five-component design rubric. Legacy normalized scores were retained only for audit and were not used to derive component levels. The snapshot is bound to exact source evidence and the current validator recomputes scores.

recertifier.provider_model_provenance_claim: No Anthropic/Sonnet call is claimed for these reconstructed judgments.

component_findings.dependency_declaration: Recertified level 4 under the current criterion: Direct dependencies can be declared explicitly at an appropriate project/module boundary rather than inferred from ambient state. Evidence basis: Current import/package semantics distinguish quoted local imports from installed packages, reject cycles, control re-exports, resolve exact stable release tags and lock transitive content hashes, making visibility and resolution explicit. Preserved paid evidence additionally records: Source packages only; single main.qui entrypoint | No install scripts executed on package install | Exact release tags only, never floating branches | Conjunctive SemVer range operators: eq, lt, lte, gt, gte | Closed manifest key set; unknown key is a compile-time error | Lockfile v3 records distribution name, import name, version, and SHA-256 content hash | ABI/IR/package-schema/lockfile-schema versions independently declared in project.toml compat block | Minimal external tool dependency: git for source installs; curl and tar only for optional platform assets | repo/docs/packages.md | repo/docs/development.md | Quidra dependency model is simple at the language level: packages are plain source packages with a single main.qui entrypoint and an optional flat-key quidra.package manifest. Dependency resolution uses conjunctive SemVer ranges against exact immutable release tags only; no floating or branch dependencies are ever installed. No package install script is executed. Optional platform assets never participate in dependency resolution or execute behavior; the installer inspects archives and rejects traversal/symlink/protected-file overwrite attempts. Distribution name, import name, display name, and repository are cleanly separated identities so a package cannot silently redefine reserved language surface. quidra.lock v3 records distribution name, import name, version, and…

metric.dependency_simplicity.selection_rule: Judge language/module dependency semantics and intrinsic project dependency model. Registry size, package-manager maturity and community conventions belong to Ecosystem.

component_findings.artifact_source_separation: Recertified level 4 under the current criterion: Source-level program meaning is not unnecessarily tied to a single compiler ABI, filesystem convention or host-specific build assumption. Evidence basis: Current architecture keeps semantics in the frontend and typed IR, treats LLVM as an implementation target, specifies numeric/storage semantics independently of host details and centralizes platform declarations; platform abstraction/conditional mechanisms remain less complete than the strongest mature multi-target designs. Preserved paid evidence additionally records: Frontend and native-lowering phase separation: language semantics belong to the frontend, LLVM is an implementation target | Typed IR documented as seam supporting future backend work beyond the current LLVM and Clang pipeline | Backend transformations must not recover missing semantic facts from source spellings, LLVM pointer shapes, or control-flow layout | Tensor device placement modeled as explicit metadata separate from dtype and shape types | ABI/IR/package-schema/lockfile-schema versions declared independently in project.toml compat block, decoupled from compiler release version | project.toml declared single source of truth for supported operating systems, targets, and toolchain minimums | Release checks require GCC and Clang release builds plus Linux, macOS, and Windows CI | repo/docs/spec/architecture.md | repo/docs/development.md | Quidra language design is platform-neutral at the semantic layer while using LLVM as one concrete implementation backend. The architecture spec states language semantics belong to the frontend and LLVM is an implementation target, with typed IR documented as the seam separating semantic checks from native representation and supporting future backend work. Backend transformations may not recover missing semantic facts by guessing from source spellings, LLVM pointer shapes, or incidental control-flow layout, so the checked language contract…
